purpose: Make the canonical task_follow_up roster member operational as a provider-neutral, permission-aware competence whose only possible product effect is one matched ordinary Task through existing project classification and PostgreSQL authority.
success_outcome: One strict provider-neutral task_follow_up invocation over current authorized PostgreSQL Task/Outcome/evidence records can emit only a check, measurement, or follow_up proposal. A successfully audited post-model guard denial or speak/envelope handoff commits exactly one immutable run/fingerprint runtime disposition as publication_denied or envelope_handed_off; context_denied, runtime_not_configured, provider_failed, output_invalid, passing-guard model_silent, and audit_failed commit none. A matching classification and current ordinary-task guard create exactly one same-kind Task through the existing classified disposition and sole Task writer, which atomically stores an independent expected Task-create fingerprint without persisting candidate text or the full envelope. PostgreSQL makes that commitment write-once after insert: every distinct digest replacement or null/value transition is rejected with the canonical 23514 diagnostic and coordinates a full transaction rollback. Consumed replay requires the preserved commitment to equal the Task fingerprint and canonical text/kind/ordered-source preimage, with ActorContext/scope/agent/classification checked separately; legacy null and every mismatch return redacted null-ref disposition failure. Existing TaskFollowUpRunResultV1 remains unchanged; strict competence-local TaskFollowUpDispositionResultV1 resolves conflict, persistence failure, incomplete/non-taskable handoff, downstream denied/consumed, and replay-blocked retries with exact safe refs and no stale envelope or executor/writer calls. The seven required collision/crash/lock/race groups prove no replay or contradictory effect and new command/run/message eligibility. W1 Outcome evidence remains closed; acceptance stays provider-neutral with no provider/model/base URL/credential/egress/network/live-smoke requirement or claim.

constraints: TaskFollowUpProviderRequestV1 contains only the canonical definition, trigger, backend-allowed ordinary kinds, and one to four authorized PostgreSQL task/outcome/evidence records with matching ordered refs.
Task text is an explicit typed untrusted quotation and never an instruction, prompt, tool, command, authorization, evidence fact, or route selector.
The model result may speak only one allowed check, measurement, or follow_up proposal or produce strict model-declared silence; action and every mutation field are schema-invalid.
A non-silent result creates only a pending task_request MessageEnvelope; the existing project classifier must persist the exact same safe_task_kind before TASK-039 may create a Task.

The strict provider-neutral seam has no selected provider/model/base URL; production remains unbound and fail-closed, test fakes/spies are explicit, I/O is outside transactions, and every owning writer repeats current guards.

The task_follow_up runtime stage writes only the additive ft012_runtime_dispositions authority after model I/O under a short run-key advisory lock; the same lock and exact handed-off identity are required by the downstream classified Task writer, and no transaction/lock spans Task model or Safety-classifier I/O.

TaskFollowUpInvocationResultV1 is the task-local union of unchanged TaskFollowUpRunResultV1 and strict TaskFollowUpDispositionResultV1; the latter has exact result_status/result_code/nullability/ref semantics and never widens global AgentRuntimeOutcomeV1.

Only successfully audited publication_guard_denied and envelope_ready branches create the two-value runtime disposition; context_denied, runtime_not_configured, provider_failed, output_invalid, passing-guard model_silent, and audit_failed create none and retain their existing same-run retry path.
W1 record_follow_up_outcome keeps its closed evidence resolver and rejects task:/outcome: refs; W2 Task/Outcome source-record lookup is competence-specific and cannot be reused by the Outcome writer.

Every new consumed ordinary_task_dispatch_dispositions row stores expected_task_create_fingerprint equal to the writer-computed classified-message Task create fingerprint in the same Task/audit/disposition UoW; denied rows store null. A named PostgreSQL BEFORE UPDATE trigger rejects every distinct post-insert commitment change, including digest replacement and null/value transitions, with SQLSTATE 23514 and stable diagnostic constraint ck_ordinary_task_dispatch_commitment_write_once. Pre-existing consumed rows are not self-derived/backfilled and replay-fail on null; no candidate text or full MessageEnvelope becomes durable.

Deterministic acceptance requires exact task_follow_up and Safety fake/spy calls plus exactly one ordinary Task; fallback, production fake, silence, blocked, failed, mismatch, or direct action effect is not acceptance.
invariants: Model output, its proposed kind, MessageEnvelope, and classification are candidate/routing data; only the current TASK-039 ordinary-task service writes mutable Task authority.
The task_follow_up agent can never create action, approve or reject, complete a Task, record an Outcome, confirm Plant state, or produce a device effect.
UI Feed, Bus history, Timeline replay, raw chat, ActorContext/session/grant payloads, caller refs, prompts, provider history, hidden reasoning, and credentials never enter provider input.
Archived or unauthorized Plant state creates no model-backed Task effect and restore never replays the denied run.

Every successfully audited publication_guard_denied or envelope_ready branch has exactly one immutable runtime-stage disposition; other common runtime outcomes have none. publication_denied and the same run's classified consumed/denied state cannot coexist, and envelope_handed_off never mints or replays a second message.

A consumed task_follow_up replay is exact only when Task.create_request_fingerprint, the PostgreSQL write-once classified-disposition expected fingerprint, and canonical recomputation over normalized text/kind/ordered sources plus trusted run/message identity all agree, while ActorContext/scope/agent/classification attribution matches separately; any missing or mismatched value fails redacted with null refs and zero replay calls, and coordinated attempts to replace the commitment abort and roll back before replay.
Test fakes/spies are explicit seams only; no fake, canned, hardcoded, fallback, or failure-silence production path satisfies acceptance.
